plain_english: Oṃ hrīṃ, to Kaumārī: perform the worship beginning with the heart twice and three times, offer sandalwood, unbroken rice, flowers, incense, lamp, food, and so forth, and then recite the hymn.
sanskrit_cite: 12a) oṃ hrī kaumārya 2 3 hṛdayādipūjā candanākṣatapūspadhūpadipanaivedyādikaṃ datvā japya stotra

plain_english: To Tuṃvureśvarī: perform invocation and related acts twice from the southeast to the northeast, then perform the complete worship; oṃ, perform the invocation beginning with 'to the infinite' and so forth.
sanskrit_cite: tuṃvureśvarīya 2 āgnayādi īśānāntaṃ āvāhanādī 0 tatosalapūjā oṃ ānaṃtāyatyādi āvāhanā
